name: ZIM Default Frontend
description: The default ZIM frontend: the application chrome (tab strip + omnibox + split view), the completed new-tab page (search, recents, create/import, themes + uploaded engine themes), server list, server console with add-on surface contributions, the file manager (breadcrumb navigation, upload/download, rename/delete, archive/extract over the §10.3 file family), the backup manager (create/restore/download/lock/delete over the §10.5 family, with live durable-job following), the schedule manager (create/pause/run-now/delete over the §10.6 cron family), the subuser manager (add/edit-grants/remove over the §10.7 family and the real PermissionGrant vocabulary), the settings surface (the §10.3 PATCH family under the §8 If-Match concurrency gate, with the danger-zone delete), the add-ons management page, the About page (shell/engine versions + the update channel's check), and the declared per-instance surfaces.
author: ZaminMC
